solver_notes: Replace pointer-only CAS with an atomic 128-bit {pointer, uint64_t epoch} head. Every successful push/pop increments the epoch; acquire loads pair with acq_rel success and acquire failure order. A stale A->B->A head therefore fails CAS even when its address is identical. The deterministic test first proves that a legacy pointer-only CAS accepts the recycled A state, then proves tagged CAS rejects it. Baseline LIFO and empty-queue behavior also pass. This isolates ABA from reclamation: production code that frees nodes must retain hazard-pointer/epoch reclamation; the 64-bit tag does not by itself make unsafe free() legal. Internal file_sha256_of_this_json is the SHA-256 of the compact UTF-8 JSON object with this field set to null (self-reference avoided); the bus payload_sha256 is SHA-256 of the actual transmitted file bytes.
